description: Sri lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 25.05.2015 to 31.01.2015
reasoning: This gazette notification announces new rates of exchange for customs duties and other charges under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It constitutes a regulatory framework for customs valuation and represents a statutory instrument issued by the Director General of Customs under delegated authority. The content focuses on legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
